title: risk_review.py stops with 'no merge base' on the default shallow clone, and reviews 0 files before the work is committed
problem: CLAUDE.md tells every run to run `python3 platform/security/risk_review.py`. In a cloud session's shallow clone origin/main shares no commit with HEAD, so it exited 2 with a hint and each run then fetched deeper or guessed --base HEAD~<n> by hand. Run before committing, it diffed commits only and reported '0 changed file(s)' without saying why.
evidence: grep -l risk_review prompts/runs/*.json | xargs grep -li 'merge base\|merge-base\|shallow' | wc -l: 24 run records on 2026-11-25

promptctl.py measure, 'Doc friction by file', 2026-11-25: platform/security/risk_review.py is third (10 of the last 60 records' friction entries), after CLAUDE.md and prompt.md, several of whose entries are the same complaint
prompts/runs/2026-11-25-session_01EhTJVPPRoLDes2JLJ9t*.json: '0 changed file(s) because it diffs committed work only'
change: find_merge_base(): when --base names a remote branch and the clone is shallow, run `git fetch --deepen=40/200/500 <remote> <branch>` until the histories meet (local mode only; --gate and --no-fetch never fetch). uncommitted_note(): say how many paths are uncommitted and not reviewed. Tests in ShallowCloneTests build a real depth-1 clone.
metric: run records dated after this PR whose doc_friction names risk_review.py and 'merge base', 'shallow' or '0 changed'
